title: Git Amulet
description: JetBrains-style Git for VS Code. An opinionated spin-off of GitCharm by RioNoir, tailored to my workflow. Most users want the original: RioNoir.gitcharm.

title: YAML Scheme Validator
description: Validates YAML config files against JSON Schema (draft-07) scheme files written in YAML (sibling *.schema.yml or declared in the first line), with recursive 'extends' includes, diagnostics, completion and hover help. Compatible with the Red Hat YAML extension.

title: MoonClicker Script Workbench
description: Connect VS Code to a MoonClicker device running Script Workbench.

title: AXIOM .axm — plans for the agent write gate
description: Language support for AXIOM .axm plans (the transactional write gate for coding agents): diagnostics, completion, hover, outline, formatting and semantic highlighting.
